Messages.Author: AriusZet
Messages.Body:
Ok, my problem is the torpor rescue.

> 6.5.3. Rescue a Vampire from Torpor
> To have a vampire rescue another vampire from torpor, announce the action (including how the cost will be paid) and tap the acting vampire. If the action is successful, the cost is paid, and the vampire in torpor is moved to the ready region ... This action has a default +1 stealth and is undirected if the acting vampire and the vampire in torpor have the same controller; otherwise it is simply a directed action. A vampire rescued from torpor is no longer wounded.
>
so this is clear. if i want to rescue a vampire from torpor, from a different matuselah's torpor region, I have to announce the cost.

So CAN I do this:- "Jesus Alcala wants to rescue YOUR vampire from torpor, and YOU pay the 2 blood"
if he is not comfortable with this, he only can block this action with some ready minion? And if he cannot block it, the vampire is rescued, and the cost is paid?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> AriusZet wrote:
> if i want to rescue a vampire from torpor, from a different matuselah's torpor region, I have to announce the cost.
>
> So CAN I do this:- "Jesus Alcala wants to rescue YOUR vampire from torpor, and YOU pay the 2 blood"
>
Yes. Well, "wants" isn't really a Vtes term, but "rescues" or "attempts to rescue" are.
>
> AriusZet wrote:
> if he is not comfortable with this, he only can block this action with some ready minion?
>
Yes. Other Methuselahs can also block that  action with Eagle's Sight or similar effects.
>
> AriusZet wrote:
> And if he cannot block it, the vampire is rescued, and the cost is paid?
>
Correct.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> AriusZet wrote:
> so this is clear. if i want to rescue a vampire from torpor, from a different matuselah's torpor region, I have to announce the cost.
>
Yes, as for any action.

> AriusZet wrote:
> So CAN I do this:- "Jesus Alcala wants to rescue YOUR vampire from torpor, and YOU pay the 2 blood"
>
Yes.

> AriusZet wrote:
> if he is not comfortable with this, he only can block this action with some ready minion?
>
Globally yes (he may also cause your action to fail with cards such as Hide the Heart).

> AriusZet wrote:
> And if he cannot block it, the vampire is rescued, and the cost is paid?
>
Yes.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
